blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Retail pork prices remained high despite lower tariffs on imported pork and declining hog prices, according to the Department of Agriculture (DA). Katrin Mares of the Department of Agriculture’s (DA) Policy Research Service said the agency noted a widening gap between retail and farm-gate prices, and that both consumers and local hog raisers have not benefited from lower tariffs. READ: MITA flags price risks from higher pork tariffs “We are concerned that the tariff reduction does not impact the final market price, which is the retail price.
